title: Creativity comes from a synergy of noisy and deterministic brain modes

statements.text: Human creativity is an unintended consequence of the brain's energy efficiency. In one mode energy is spread over many neurons, so thinly that thermal and ultimately quantum decoherent noise affects them. In the other it is focused on few neurons, which then work deterministically. Creativity arises from the synergy of the two.

sources.quote: It is argued that creativity arises from a synergy between two cognitive modes of the human brain
